page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90 is a high-memory general-purpose instance powered by x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. It provides 90 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 45 physical cores with 2 threads per core, backed by 720 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB per core ratio. The architecture includes instruction set extensions such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance contains zero GPUs, provides no bundled local NVMe storage, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying entirely on network-attached storage and network routing.

Benchmark results demonstrate significant compute capacity and strong memory subsystem performance across multi-threaded loads. The instance achieved a top-tier PassMark CPU score of 87,517.3, supported by top-tier extended instructions (115,339.44) and encryption (100,770.46) metrics. Multi-threaded compilation via Clang reached 60,172.0 and Geekbench ray tracing reached 99,342.0, both placing in the top 10%. Memory read bandwidth for large blocks reached 218.2 GB/sec, while cached small-block reads delivered 6,374.57 GB/sec. In-memory operations registered strong performance, with Redis reaching 117.38 million SET operations per second and PassMark database operations scoring 28,335.01.

Single-core execution metrics reflect standard baseline speeds, with Geekbench single-core scoring 1,877.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 27.58 GB/sec. Large uncached write bandwidth is moderate at 77.77 GB/sec. In CPU-based machine learning inference, prompt processing reaches 3,948.93 tokens per second on small 135M models, though generation throughput scales down on 70B parameter models to 4.84 tokens per second.

Given its 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and multi-core throughput, the c3d-highmem-90 delivers high resource density for enterprise memory footprints. The absence of local disk requires external storage planning, making the platform suited for large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, software build infrastructure, and big data analytical pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90 is a high-memory compute instance featuring 90 dedicated vCPUs (45 physical cores) on AMD EPYC 9B14 x86_64 processors, combined with 720 GB of memory (8 GB per vCPU). The instance incorporates AVX-512 and cryptographic hardware acceleration, though it includes no onboard GPUs or local storage. In benchmark evaluations, it demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded processing, scoring 87,517.3 on PassMark CPU, 60,172.0 in Clang compilation, and 117.38 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks. While single-thread speeds and uncached memory writes reflect average tier performance, the massive RAM allocation and strong vector processing capabilities make this instance particularly effective for large-scale in-memory databases, Redis caches, complex software compilation pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
